results.title: Helius Solana RPC Review 2026: Free Plan, Features and Best Use Cases
results.content:
This makes Helius useful for more than one type of Solana project. A wallet may need fresh account balances and transaction notifications. A DeFi app may need fast reads and reliable transaction submission. An NFT marketplace may need token and asset data. A trading app may care about low-latency data streams and transaction landing.

## Helius Free Plan: What Is Included?

The Helius free plan is designed for testing. As of July 8, 2026, the official pricing page lists the free plan at $0 per month with:

 1 million credits
 10 requests per second
 1 `sendTransaction` per second
 `sendBundle`
 Staked Connections
 LaserStream WSS standard
 LaserStream gRPC
 Community support [...] That makes the free plan a strong starting point for prototypes, tutorials, small internal tools, early Solana apps and developers who want to test Helius before choosing a paid plan.

However, free does not mean unlimited. If your app has active users, frequent dashboard refreshes, NFT indexing, trading flows or high transaction volume, you will probably need to upgrade.

## Helius Pricing: When Should You Upgrade?

Helius has several paid tiers for projects that outgrow the free plan. The Developer plan is listed at $49 per month and includes more credits, higher request-per-second limits and chat support. The Business and Professional tiers add higher usage limits and more support for teams operating at scale. [...] ## What Does Helius Offer?

Helius provides several infrastructure products for Solana developers. The most important ones are:

 Solana RPC nodes for reading chain data and submitting transactions
 Sender for optimized transaction landing
 LaserStream for low-latency data streaming
 Webhooks and WebSockets for event monitoring
 Digital Asset Standard APIs for token and NFT queries
 Priority Fee API for smarter fee estimation
 Enhanced Transactions for decoded transaction data
 Wallet API in beta for wallet balances and transaction history
 Dedicated nodes for advanced infrastructure needs

results.content:
## Data Add-on Prices Reduced

Starting April 7th, 2026, we're lowering prices by up to 20% on data streaming add-ons. This applies to both LaserStream gRPC and Enhanced WebSocket usage.

|  |  |  |
 --- 
| Add-on Traffic | Previous Price (per month) | New Price (per month) |
| 5 TB | $500 | $400 |
| 10 TB | $900 | $750 |
| 25 TB | $2,000 | $1,750 |
| 50 TB | $3,500 | $3,250 |
| 100 TB | $6,000 | $6,000 |

Combined with the lower credit rate, the effective cost per TB drops significantly across every tier.

For example, the 10 TB add-on will cost $750/month (~$75/TB), which is competitive with every other Solana streaming provider on the market.

## Summary of Changes

Here is a concise breakdown of what these pricing changes mean for existing customers:

### Professional Plan Users [...] ## Streaming Credits Cost 33% Less

On April 7th, 2026, we're reducing the credit rate for all streaming traffic to 20 credits per 1 MB. This is a 33% reduction from the previous rate (30 credits/MB), bringing the effective base cost of streaming to approximately $100/TB — down from $150/TB previously.

## Unifying Credit Rates for gRPC & WSS

The new 20 credits per 1 MB data streaming rate will apply uniformly across both LaserStream gRPC and WebSockets. This change applies to all customers, including those on grandfathered plans. WSS traffic that was previously unmetered will be metered at the same unified rate. [...] ### WSS Users

If you're using WSS on a legacy plan, WSS streaming will be metered starting 30 days from today’s announcement (May 1st, 2026), and will be billed at the same 20 credits/MB rate as gRPC.

Please review your dashboard to check current WebSockets usage, and reach out to our team for help.

## Timeline

Here’s a quick summary of what’s changing over the next 30 days:

### Day 0 (March 31st)

All changes announced. WSS metering grace period begins.

### Day 7 (April 7th)

Unified credit rate, expanded access, and add-on improvements begin.

### Day 30 (May 1st)

WSS metering activates for all projects. The 30-day grace period ends.

results.title: Best Helius Alternatives: RPC, gRPC and Transaction Landing (2026) | RPC Fast
results.content:
### Helius baseline: Best self-service product breadth

Helius remains a strong default for Solana-native teams that want one account for RPC, enhanced data APIs, streaming, early transaction feeds, and sending. Gatekeeper shortens the request path through Helius's edge network. LaserStream supplies Yellowstone-compatible streaming with automatic recovery and 24-hour replay. Shred Delivery adds raw UDP shreds and preprocessed transactions, while Pre Confirmations exposes scheduler-level signals before shreds exist.

Sender broadcasts through Helius, Jito, Harmonic, Rakurai, and other routes. The SWQoS-only path starts at a 0.000005 SOL minimum tip, while Sender Max requires at least 0.001 SOL. Sender is available on every plan and does not consume API credits.

Best for: [...] | Provider | Strongest fit | Real-time data | Early transaction data | Transaction delivery | Infrastructure and pricing |
 ---  ---  --- |
| Helius | Solana-native products needing broad APIs plus trading tools | LaserStream gRPC/WSS, 24-hour replay | Preconfirmations, raw shreds, preprocessed transactions | Sender, staked connections, Jito and partner paths | Shared plans; dedicated from $2,900/month |
| RPC Fast | Bots, HFT, MEV, and high-load Solana backends | Yellowstone gRPC, WebSockets, Aperture | Shredstream gRPC and Aperture | Beam, partner SWQoS, standard RPC | Free and paid SaaS; dedicated from $2,200/month; HA clusters | [...] ## Why consider a Helius alternative?

Helius already covers most of the Solana infrastructure stack. Its current platform includes RPC and archival methods, Gatekeeper edge routing, LaserStream gRPC and WebSockets, 24-hour replay, raw shreds, decoded preprocessed transactions, scheduler-level preconfirmations, Sender, staked connections, enhanced APIs, and dedicated nodes.

Mainnet LaserStream gRPC starts with the $499 Business plan, raw shreds cost $1,000 per month per IP or $800 on Professional, and dedicated nodes start at $2,900 per month.

results.content:
It's a Pro plan plus data add-ons. After Helius's April 2026 ~20% price cut, the 5 TB add-on is $500/month, the 10 TB add-on is $750/month, and the 100 TB add-on is $6,000/month. Overage is 2 credits per 0.1 MB. Above 100 TB you contact sales. Raw Yellowstone gRPC pricing varies by provider; on NoLimitNodes it's $49/month (Pro) or $199/month (Ultra) with no per-byte meter. [...] ## Pricing compared

LaserStream rolls under the Helius Pro plan with data add-ons. The April 2026 cut dropped per-TB by about 20%. Self-hosted Yellowstone is whatever a dedicated Solana validator costs you (~$2,000-$4,000/month for a tuned bare-metal box, plus the engineering hours to keep it running).
